observations: Photo 0 shows a copier/printer unit wrapped in plastic on a table/floor, with a label visible but no clear brand/model readable.
No close-up of control panel, output tray, paper tray, ports, or any display/error codes.
No photo of the drum/toner area, counter/page count screen, or test print/copy sample.

claims.evidence: Photo 0 does not show readable brand/model or clear multifunction features (scan/copy/fax) or specifications.
Photo 0 shows the unit wrapped; cleanliness inside/around vents and paper path cannot be confirmed.
No test print/copy sample is shown.
No counter/page count screen or meter reading is visible.

claims.claim: New drum and toner just fitted, no paper jam.
claims.evidence: No photo of drum/toner installation, and no evidence of a successful run (no jam-free test).

risks.risk: Brand/model is not readable, so compatibility of parts, service history, and typical market value cannot be matched to the comparables.
risks.proof: Ask for a clear photo of the machine’s nameplate/model label and the control panel showing the model and status.
risks.if_unproven: Price at the worst-case within the provided range only if model is confirmed; otherwise treat as not reliably comparable.

risks.risk: Page count claim may be false; high usage can mean worn rollers, fuser, and drum.
risks.proof: Ask for a screenshot/photo of the machine’s total counter/page meter screen.
risks.if_unproven: Price as higher-usage (worst case) rather than “under 20,000”.

risks.risk: “New drum and toner” may be untrue or may not be properly seated; could cause poor prints or damage.
risks.proof: Ask for a close-up photo of the drum/toner compartments and a short video of the machine completing a full copy cycle.
risks.if_unproven: Price as if drum/toner may be worn or not functioning correctly.

risks.risk: “No paper jam” is unverified; paper path issues may appear only after several sheets or specific paper sizes.
risks.proof: Ask for a clip showing continuous copying (e.g., 20–30 pages) without jams and with paper feeding from the tray.
risks.if_unproven: Price as if it may jam/need paper-path service.

risks.risk: Multifunction capability (scan/print/copy) is not shown; could be copy-only or partially faulty.
risks.proof: Ask for a photo/video showing scan to email/USB (or at least scan preview) and printing/copying.
risks.if_unproven: Price as copy-only or partially functional.

proof_requests: Clear photo of the model/brand nameplate (front/side) and the control panel (with any menu/status).
Photo/screenshot of the total counter/page meter screen.
Close-up of drum and toner compartments (showing installed parts) plus a short video of a successful copy run.
Video/clip of continuous copying (enough pages to reveal jams) and a sample test print.
response.reason: Only one wrapped photo is provided and the brand/model and key proof points (page counter, test copy, jam-free run, drum/toner condition) are not verifiable from the images. Without the model, the item cannot be reliably matched to the comparables for a safe price.
